o.text: Internationalism. From Russian архи́в (arxív), ultimately from Ancient Greek ἀρχεῖον (arkheîon).
From Proto-Turkic *tan-. Cognate with Chuvash тун (tun).
Borrowed from Arabic خُصُوصًا (ḵuṣūṣan), adverbial accusative of خُصُوص (ḵuṣūṣ). By surface analysis, xüsus + -ən.
Borrowed from Mongolic, from Proto-Mongolic *tokoi (“elbow, river bend”). See more at Kazakh тоғай (toğay).
